title: Listen and Choose a Response — Computer Trouble

questions.stem: My laptop crashed and I lost half my paper.

options.A: I wrote the paper in the library.
options.B: The IT help desk might be able to recover it.
options.C: Did anyone get hurt in the crash?
options.D: My new laptop is really light.

questions.explanation: Pointing to the IT help desk is a helpful reply; 'crash' as an accident is the wrong meaning.
questions.speaker: m6
